# Waveform Player

## Summary
Catalog audio player component with a waveform visualization, part of the
catalog audio field family. Lives in the catalog realm at
`fields/audio/components/waveform-player` (named export `WaveformPlayer`).

## API
- `@model` — an `AudioFieldModel` (exposes the audio `url`)
- `@player` — a `BaseAudioPlayer` that owns playback state and wires the
  underlying `<audio>` element via `{{@player.setupAudio}}`

## Usage
Consumed by the catalog audio field's formats; reuse it by constructing the
field's player primitives rather than instantiating standalone. Live
examples ship with the catalog audio field listing.
